headline: Contrast media and pharma intermediate segment recovering

highlights: This is in line with the company’s guidance of a strong outlook for FY27 for its two critical segments – contrast media and pharma intermediate.
We note the PI segment, particularly, could experience volatile quarters, depending upon supplies to innovators.
Even so, we believe revenue momentum could sustain for H2FY27 as well.

BlueJet has seen margin pressure from sharp rises in prices for ancillary chemicals such as reagents and solvents, which are not part of its pass-through mechanism; the company is making efforts to raise prices for select products and customers.
valuation: Upside risks: Faster-than-expected ramp-up of new products with higher margins, and more long-term contracts that improve the outlook and re-rate valuations.
